verdict.reasoning: This object describes one coherent trend-continuation trade, not two opposite setups fused together: the trader already has a long bias for the session, price opens near VWAP/fair value, runs up, reaches the first or second standard-deviation band, then after that level is broken and retested the entry is a long, with the second and third standard deviations used as continuation targets. All of those conditions can occur in a single trade instance and point in the same direction; the object does not simultaneously require a mean-reversion short back to VWAP or any opposite-direction logic.
